title: Population RNA Seq of human HSPCs (Lineage negative, CD38 negative, CD34 positive) of control patients or myocardial infarction patients and treated with at-RA/4-oxo-RA/DMSO for 72h in culture
description: Study of the transcriptomic changes in human HSPCs under the influence of at-RA and 4-oxo-RA. Human Hematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells (HSPCs)(Lineage negative, CD38 negative, CD34 positive cells) were isolated from sternal bone marrow of patients who had experienced myocardial infarction or from control patients. For in vitro cultivation, cells were treated with at-RA (2.5 μM final concentration), 4-oxo-RA (2.5 μM final concentration), or the respective volume of DMSO (control) for 72 hours. After incubation period, cells were harvested for RNA extraction.

samples.title: human_HSPC_4oxo_Ctrl_1
samples.description: Protocols: Human HSPCs (Lineage negative, CD38 negative, CD34 positive) isolated from sternal bone marrow of myocardial infarction patients or control patients were sorted into low-attachment 96-well plates containing StemSpan SFEM II media (StemCell Technologies) supplemented with StemSpanª CD34+ Expansion Supplement (StemCell Technologies). For in vitro cultivation, at-RA (2.5 _M final concentration), 4-oxo-RA (2.5 _M final concentration), or the respective volume of DMSO was added to the culture medium. Cells were cultured for 72h prior to harvest for RNA extraction. After culturing the cells, the low-attachment 96-well plate was centrifuged at 400g for 5 minutes. The cell culture medium was carefully removed using a pipette, and the cells were subsequently extracted into lysis buffer (Arcturus PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Applied Biosystems)). Cells were then stored at -80¡C until further use. RNA isolation was conducted using the Arcturus PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Applied Biosystems) following the manufacturer's guidelines. DNAse treatment was carried out employing the RNase-Free DNase Set (Qiagen). The resulting total RNA was utilized for generating cDNA libraries. cDNA libraries were generated using SMARTseq v4 (Takara Bio). 13 cycles of amplification were performed. To produce uniquely- and dually-barcoded sequencing libraries from the cDNA libraries, the NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA library kit (NEB) was utilized. This involved fragmenting 5 ng of the cDNA library for 22.5 minutes, followed by adaptor ligation and library amplification using cycle numbers determined by amount of input material.
